results.name: rsi_oversold_tight

results.name: inside_day_breakout_default
results.thesis: Inside-day contraction followed by a breakout is a volatility-contraction signal that should show up more often in the current low-vol tape than in choppier regimes, with cleaner follow-through.

results.name: bb_lower_touch_tight
results.thesis: With realized vol this low, the default 2.0-std lower band rarely gets touched. Tightening to 1.5 std should generate enough real mean-reversion signals; short hold to capture the quick snapback.

results.name: bb_lower_touch_wide
results.thesis: A wider window and stricter 2.5-std band is a higher-conviction extreme-deviation signal for when the market does have a real drawdown; longer hold to let a bigger reversion play out.

results.name: bb_squeeze_breakout_default
results.thesis: Low realized vol means Bollinger squeezes are common right now. A breakout from a squeeze inside a mild 3-month uptrend should have decent follow-through rather than reverting immediately.

results.name: macd_bull_cross_fast
results.thesis: A faster MACD pair should catch momentum shifts sooner in a low-vol grind, where the incumbent 12/26/9 cross can be slow to trigger on subtle moves.

results.name: buy_dip_ma_shallow

results.name: buy_dip_ma_long_ma

results.name: low_52w_bounce_tight

results.name: three_red_days_quick

results.name: failed_breakout_short_default

results.name: high_volume_hammer_lowvol

results.name: golden_cross_classic

results.name: death_cross_short_classic

results.name: n_day_breakout_20

results.name: gap_up_continuation_default

results.name: turn_of_month_default

results.name: n_day_breakout_40
